chunks.arabic_text: ٣٢٧٢ - وَرَوَى ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ ٱلْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ

translations.en: 3272 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ يَقُولُ :

translations.en: I heard Aba Ja'far عليه السلام saying:

chunks.arabic_text: "إِنِّي كُنْتُ عِنْدَ قَاضٍ مِنْ قُضَاةِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلَانِ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا إِنِّي ٱكْتَرَيْتُ مِنْ هَذَا دَابَّةً لِيُبَلِّغَنِي عَلَيْهَا مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا إِلَى كَذَا وَكَذَا فَلَمْ يُبَلِّغْنِي ٱلْمَوْضِعَ فَقَالَ ٱلْقَاضِي لِصَاحِبِ ٱلدَّابَّةِ بَلَّغْتَهُ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْضِعِ قَالَ لَا قَدْ أَعْيَتْ دَابَّتِي فَلَمْ تَبْلُغْ فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلْقَاضِي لَيْسَ لَكَ كِرَاءٌ إِذْ لَمْ تُبَلِّغْهُ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْضِعِ ٱلَّذِي ٱكْتَرَى دَابَّتَكَ إِلَيْهِ"

translations.en: "I was with a judge from among the judges of al-Madinah when two men came to him. One of them said: 'Indeed, I hired from this man an animal to carry me on it from such-and-such to such-and-such, but it did not bring me to the destination.' So the judge said to the owner of the animal, 'Did you bring him to the destination?' He said, 'No. My animal became exhausted, so it did not reach.' The judge then said to him, 'You are entitled to no hire, since you did not bring him to the destination for which he hired your animal.'"

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ "فَدَعَوْتُهُمَا إِلَيَّ فَقُلْتُ لِلَّذِي ٱكْتَرَى لَيْسَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدَ ٱللَّهِ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ بِكِرَاءِ دَابَّةِ ٱلرَّجُلِ كُلِّهِ وَقُلْتُ لِلْآخَرِ يَا عَبْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَيْسَ لَكَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ كِرَاءَ دَابَّتِكَ كُلَّهُ وَلَكِنِ ٱنْظُرْ قَدْرَ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْضِعِ وَقَدْرَ مَا رَكِبْتَهُ فَٱصْطَلِحَا عَلَيْهِ " فَفَعَلَا.

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "So I called them to me and said to the one who hired it: 'You have no right, O servant of Allah, to take away the entire hire of the man's animal.' And I said to the other: 'You have no right, O servant of Allah, to take the full hire for your animal. Rather, look at the amount of the distance that remains and the amount that you rode, then reach a reconciliation upon that.' So they did so.

en.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling on partial performance in a hiring contract involving transport. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام rejects both extremes—denying the owner all payment or granting him the full fare—and instead directs an equitable settlement proportional to the completed and remaining distance.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if a hired animal or transport does not complete the agreed journey?

key_terms.دَابَّةً: a riding animal hired for transport
key_terms.ٱكْتَرَيْتُ: I hired or rented for use
key_terms.فَٱصْطَلِحَا: make a mutual settlement or reconciliation
